The editor and render come in the next trial — for now this proves the YouTube download and the cloud draft work.

The draft runs on your Modal backend (the same one the desktop app uses). This app can’t deploy one. Paste one line: your backend URL and your API key, separated by a space — like the KaraokeNow ReVanced setup.
Paste the backend URL and the API key on one line, like: https://…modal.run your-key
The backend URL must start with https://
That line has no API key. Paste the URL and the key together, separated by a space.

Create a free Modal account, then paste the whole token command Modal gives you. Your own KaraokeGen backend is deployed into YOUR Modal account. The token is used once for that deploy and is never saved on this phone. Already set up before? It just reconnects to your existing server, usually under a minute. Brand-new account? The first build takes 5–10 minutes, once only.
Paste the whole `modal token set …` command from Modal.
Your backend is ready — go back and tap Start.
